SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.`U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY avg_HCT DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
